source.market_name: Will 5 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

market_name: Will 5 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the 2y/10y Treasury yields and fed funds futures (SOFR strip) have moved in the same dovish direction; confirm the move is not idiosyncratic to the Polymarket contract.
time_plan.1h: Re-check TLT price vs move in 2y yield and OIS-implied 2026 cut count; look for confirmation from Fed-speak headlines or data surprises.
time_plan.2h: Assess persistence: is TLT holding gains or fading? Compare with a broader duration proxy (IEF) to gauge curve shape.
time_plan.6h: Reassess against any scheduled macro releases (CPI, jobs, FOMC minutes) that could be the true driver; discount if news is already public.
time_plan.12h: Final read on TLT vs starting level; note whether the dovish repricing stuck or reversed and whether prediction-market move led or lagged rates.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 5 Fed rate cuts in 2026 signals a materially more dovish rate path than currently priced. That pulls the expected fed funds trajectory lower, which lowers the front-to-belly of the curve and tends to lift duration-sensitive long bonds. TLT is the most liquid, direct expression of falling US rate expectations.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm DXY and EURUSD are moving consistently with a dovish US repricing rather than a global risk event.
time_plan.1h: Check whether the dollar move is US-specific (rate-driven) or a broad risk-on/off flow that would muddy the signal.
time_plan.2h: Compare UUP with 2y US-Germany rate spread to verify the rates channel is driving FX.
time_plan.6h: Watch for offsetting dovish moves from ECB/BoJ that could neutralize the differential.
time_plan.12h: Final check on UUP vs open; judge whether the dollar weakened as the cut-expectation thesis implies.

predictions.reasoning: More expected Fed cuts narrow US rate differentials versus other G10 central banks, which typically weakens the dollar. UUP tracks the broad DXY-style basket and is the liquid proxy. Effect is weaker and noisier than the rates channel because FX also depends on relative foreign central-bank paths.

evidence_used: Market question ties resolution directly to the count of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026
A rise in probability of 5 cuts = more dovish expected policy path
Standard macro transmission: lower expected policy rate -> lower Treasury yields, weaker USD
TLT and UUP are highly liquid proxies for these channels
uncertainty_notes: Prediction-market probability moves are noisy and may reflect thin liquidity rather than genuine information
12h window is far too short for a 700bps move in these macro ETFs; not tradable under the threshold
Dovish repricing may already be public (driven by CPI/FOMC), so the prediction market lags rather than leads
The 'military_conflict' topic tag appears mislabeled; treat the question purely as a rates question

llm_justification.summary: The market prices how many 25bp Fed cuts occur in 2026. A sharp rise in the implied probability of 5 cuts represents a more dovish expected policy path than currently discounted. The cleanest downstream implications are falling US rate expectations (long Treasuries/TLT up) and a softer dollar (UUP down) via narrower rate differentials. Both are directionally sensible but modest over a 12h window and fall well short of the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is a low-conviction research mapping rather than a signal.
key_assumptions: An observed anomaly means the implied probability of 5 cuts rose sharply
Rate expectations transmit to TLT and USD in the usual macro direction
No dominant offsetting global risk shock during the window
failure_modes: The dovish shift was already public (post-CPI or post-FOMC), so assets already moved and no edge remains
Prediction-market move is liquidity noise, not information, and reverses
TLT/UUP driven by unrelated global flows, weakening the proxy link
Direction of the probability move is opposite to assumed (fewer cuts priced), flipping both trades
Magnitudes far below the 700bps threshold make this untradable in practice
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
